title: Reading Drill — Testing Sounds in a Stone Hall
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Testing Sounds in a Stone Hall
passages.body:
**A** A music group clapped in several places in a stone hall and recorded the time before the echo died away. The longest echo was heard near the entrance.

**B** Temporary curtains reduced echo near the walls but made little difference in the middle. The group next moved its chairs closer together to improve the sound reaching listeners.

**C** The last test used a small audience. Their winter coats absorbed sound, so the musicians noted the season when describing the results.

questions.prompt: A music group clapped in several places in a stone hall and recorded the time before the ______ died away.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: A music group clapped in several places in a stone hall and recorded the time before the echo died away.

questions.explanation: The group next moved its chairs closer together to improve the sound reaching listeners.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Their winter coats absorbed sound, so the musicians noted the season when describing the results.

questions.prompt: The hall originally served as a courthouse.
